title: Kokonaiskokemus oli positiivinen
subtitle: Review lesson — reading a real review start to finish

blocks.text: No new grammar today. Five lessons in, you already own enough Finnish to read a full, real review from this corpus almost word for word. This lesson is a checkpoint: a quick recap of everything so far, then one complete review, fully annotated, so you can see all five lessons working together at once.
Recap — Lesson 2: Hinta and korjaamo, on → oli

items.en: An annual service was done on the car.
I would recommend a different repair shop.

blocks.text: Now — a real review, fully annotated

blocks.title: Read it once unaided first
blocks.text: Before looking at the annotations below, read the Finnish sentences on their own and see how much you already understand. Then check yourself against the breakdown. This is the whole point of five lessons of pattern-building — this text should feel far more readable than it would have looked to you on day one.

blocks.content: Autoon {tehtiin|grammar|passive past|was done} vuosihuolto, ja kokonaiskokemus {oli|grammar|past tense of 'on'|was} positiivinen. Sain ajan nopeasti, mikä helpotti arjen järjestelyjä.

Asiakas{palvelu|word|noun|service} {oli|grammar|past tense of 'on'|was} ystävällistä ja asiallista koko käynnin ajan. Huolto valmistui sujuvasti ja melko nopeasti, ja auto saatiin takaisin sovitussa ajassa.

Työn laatu vaikutti hyvältä, {eikä|grammar|negation, 'and not'|and no} mitään {ongelmia|word|noun, partitive plural|problems} ilmennyt huollon jälkeen. Myös hinnoittelu {oli|grammar|past tense of 'on'|was} mielestäni {kohtuullinen|word|adjective|reasonable}. Voin suositella paikkaa muillekin.

blocks.title: A handful of bonus words in this text
blocks.text: Asiakaspalvelu is just asiakas (customer) + palvelu — another compound you can now decode yourself. Kokonaiskokemus means 'overall experience' (kokonais- + kokemus). Positiivinen and nopeasti (quickly) are close enough to their English/international cousins to guess. Ilmennyt is a past participle like the ones from Lesson 3, from ilmetä 'to appear/arise' — mitään ongelmia ei ilmennyt, 'no problems appeared'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What was the experience at the car service like?

lines.speaker: B
lines.fi: Kokonaiskokemus oli positiivinen. Palvelu oli ystävällistä, ja hinta oli kohtuullinen.
lines.en: The overall experience was positive. The service was friendly, and the price was reasonable.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No. I can recommend the place to others too.

blocks.title: What you now own after five lessons
items: hinta, korjaamo, and the on → oli past tense (Lesson 2)
vika, ongelma, rikki, and en/ei/eivät negation, including ei + past participle (Lesson 3)
the passive past -ttiin/-tiin: tehtiin, vaihdettiin, veloitettiin (Lesson 4)
the conditional -isi-: suosittelisin, olisi pitänyt, kannattaisi (Lesson 5)
You can now read a genuine, unsimplified Finnish car-service review almost in full
You can spot new compound words and passive/participle verbs on sight, even before knowing their exact meaning
